source.title: MorphingNet: Symbolic Regression Where the Network Is the Formula
reported_claims_not_reproduced: R^2 > 0.999 on 96–97% of 130 SRBench problems at three lower noise levels and 70% at the highest noise level
Generating formula recovered on 96 of 104 targets whose functions are in the tested library
About five minutes on GPU for one million samples, reported as 123x faster than Operon in the authors' setup

work_item.objective: Evaluate continuous-form symbolic regression under matched data, split, evaluator and total-resource budgets against symbolic-search and neural-symbolic alternatives.
acceptance_gates: Freeze source/code/model/dataset/split hashes and environment before execution.
Use disjoint grouped held-out and extrapolation splits, not random-row splits alone.
Match wall-clock and resource budgets and retain failed runs, retries, false discoveries and counterexamples.
Measure exact recovery where ground truth exists, held-out/extrapolation error, formula complexity and constraint violations.
Record CPU/GPU time, training/inference, peak memory, energy if measured, and cost per accepted formula under one cost-basis identifier.
Require dimensional, symmetry, conservation, causality and limiting-case checks before any physical-candidate gate.
Require independent evaluation and reproducibility before claiming a computational benchmark win.
work_item.falsifier: The claimed advantage disappears under matched budgets or held-out/extrapolation evaluation, depends on leakage or excluded failures, violates constraints, fails independent reproduction, or has no lower total cost per accepted formula.
non_claims: No MorphingNet implementation or source-paper reproduction.
No new physical law or verified physical equation.
No real-QPU job, quantum advantage, memory/storage replacement or Data-Center-to-Phone result.
No material substitution, accepted bio-oil, net fusion electricity or financing-rate effect.
